document.title: Form PENS.E/8 — Payment Instructions for a Benefit under Article 40(c)

chunks.part: Form PENS.E/8 — Payment Instructions for a Benefit under Article 40(c)
chunks.heading: What form PENS.E/8 is used for
chunks.text: Form PENS.E/8 is used to elect payment instructions for a benefit under article 40(c) of the UNJSPF Regulations, for participants with less than 5 years of additional contributory service after rejoining and again separating from the Fund.

chunks.part: Form PENS.E/8 — Payment Instructions for a Benefit under Article 40(c)
chunks.heading: Sections on form PENS.E/8
chunks.text: Section 1 - Participant information (UID, pension number, date of birth, name, mailing address, phone, email); Section 2 - Election of benefit (choose one of five options); Section 3 - Bank account information (applicable only if option A, B or D is elected); Section 4 - Emergency contact; Section 5 - Acknowledgement and signature.

chunks.part: Form PENS.E/8 — Payment Instructions for a Benefit under Article 40(c)
chunks.heading: Election of benefit options on form PENS.E/8
chunks.text: The participant selects ONE option only: A. Full retirement benefit (article 28); B. Full early retirement benefit (article 29); C. Deferred retirement benefit (article 30); D. Withdrawal settlement (article 31); E. Deferment of payment or choice of benefit (article 32).

chunks.part: Form PENS.E/8 — Payment Instructions for a Benefit under Article 40(c)
chunks.heading: Bank account information on form PENS.E/8
chunks.text: Section 3 (bank account information) only needs to be completed if the participant elects option A, B or D. The participant chooses either to be paid using current payment instructions on record, or to provide new bank account details, including payee name, bank name, account number/IBAN, bank ID code, currency of payment, account type, bank address, and intermediary/correspondent bank details if applicable.

chunks.part: Form PENS.E/8 — Payment Instructions for a Benefit under Article 40(c)
chunks.heading: Acknowledgements on form PENS.E/8
chunks.text: The participant confirms having read articles 32, 40 and 46 of the UNJSPF Regulations and the form's instructions, and confirms enclosing a copy of a valid government-issued photo ID and a recently dated bank statement and/or bank document, such as a voided cheque, showing all required banking information.
